note: PROD-013 raw-fetch ratchet. scripts/check-raw-api-fetch.mjs fails CI when a NEW bare fetch("/api/...") is added to a file reachable from App.tsx. Such a call skips getApiUrl (so it hits the static origin in production, not the edge function) and sends cookies instead of a Bearer JWT. Use apiRequest() from lib/queryClient, or a helper modelled on lib/invoice-pdf.ts for blob downloads. Shrink this list, never grow it: node scripts/check-raw-api-fetch.mjs --update-baseline  EVERY ENTRY HERE IS ON A ROUTED PAGE AND IS BROKEN IN PRODUCTION - this is not a list of harmless leftovers. Round 128 read that wrongly off the guard's own summary line (which printed the baselined count beside an unrelated dead-file count, both 9 at the time) and CLAUDE.md had recorded "no reachable page makes one". Four were converted once their endpoint was checked on the host production sends them to; the five below each name why a conversion would swap silence for a 404 rather than fix anything, which is SEO-TRANSPORT-001's rule: converting a page's transport sends the bill to the other host.

reasons.client/src/lib/validations.ts:/api/auth/: No edge directory for /api/auth at all, so production resolves the prefix to nothing. Converting it would make signup validation fail loudly instead of silently. The endpoint needs a home before the caller is pointed at one.
reasons.client/src/pages/LeadMapViewer.tsx:/api/: Express-only by design: CLAUDE.md records that proxying /api/leads would take import-eda from working-in-dev to 404-in-dev. Converting the transport does not change which host answers.
The admin function POST branch covers ORG_TABLES (locations, regions, teams) and not tenants, so creating a tenant is unserved in production. Platform-admin surface; needs its own pass.
